title: Acute::Rule
description: A repeating time as an iCalendar rule (RFC 5545). text is the input it was read from; description is acute's wording of it. rrule is the RRULE value alone; ical is the DTSTART, RRULE and any EXDATE lines. dtstart is a local time with its offset when the rule has a clock, else a date. cron is a 5-field line in the zone's wall time, or null with cron_reason saying why.
